short_claim: The primitive input is a positive Euclidean three-space.
detailed_claim: The whole construction starts from R^3 with the positive definite Euclidean bilinear form sip and its quadratic form q3. No Lorentzian signature, no metric on any manifold, no orientation and no spacetime is assumed at this point.
assumptions: None: this is a definitional choice of the project.
scope: Definitional; it fixes what 'primitive' means for every later claim.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Not a claim that R^3 is forced, unique or derived from anything.

short_claim: The carrier R (+) R^3 carries an intrinsic Lorentz quadratic form of signature (1,3).
detailed_claim: The spin-factor carrier LorentzCarrier = R x (Fin 3 -> R) with NS x = x0^2 - |x_vec|^2 is a four-dimensional real quadratic space of signature (1,3). The Lorentz signature is derived from the positive Euclidean datum, not postulated.
scope: Pure linear algebra of the carrier.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Does not assert that any tangent space of any manifold carries this form.

short_claim: Cl3 is the Clifford algebra of the positive Euclidean three-form, with generators squaring to +1.
detailed_claim: Cl3 = CliffordAlgebra q3 with q3 the positive Euclidean quadratic form on R^3; the generators cle i satisfy cle i * cle i = 1 and anticommute pairwise.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Not a Lorentzian Clifford algebra and not an isomorphism claim with any standard model.

short_claim: The paravector embedding realises the intrinsic quadratic form inside Cl3.
detailed_claim: spinToCl x = algebraMap R Cl3 x.1 + iota q3 x.2 satisfies spinToCl x * cconj (spinToCl x) = algebraMap R Cl3 (NS x): the Lorentz norm of the carrier is the Clifford norm of its paravector image.
scope: Bridge from the Euclidean Clifford algebra to Lorentz signature.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Does not claim Cl3 is isomorphic to a Lorentzian Clifford algebra as a quadratic-space construction.

short_claim: Clifford and Jordan structures are compatible on the embedded spin factor.
detailed_claim: The symmetrized Clifford product of two embedded carrier elements equals the image of the spin-factor Jordan product.
scope: Consistency of the two algebraic layers used by the project.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Not a classification or uniqueness theorem about Jordan algebras.

short_claim: The embedded carrier generates Cl3.
detailed_claim: The real subalgebra generated by the image of spinToCl is all of Cl3.
scope: Minimality of the Clifford layer over the carrier.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Does not claim uniqueness of the generating subspace.

short_claim: The intrinsic Spin group double covers the intrinsic Lorentz group.
detailed_claim: spinCover : SpinGroup -> GLor is a surjective group homomorphism whose kernel is central and has exactly two elements; SpinGroup and GLor are both defined intrinsically from the carrier and Cl3, with no SL(2,C) input.
forbidden_stronger_reading: GLor is the project's own group; the statement is not imported from, nor identified with, a Mathlib Lorentz group.

short_claim: The double cover is topologically qualified.
detailed_claim: SpinGroup and GLor are Hausdorff topological groups, spinCover is continuous and surjective, and its kernel is central and discrete of cardinality two.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Does not make SpinGroup a Lie group; see CLAIM-B001.

short_claim: spinCover admits continuous local sections everywhere.
detailed_claim: Around every element of GLor there is an open neighbourhood carrying a continuous section of spinCover, constructed by explicit algebraic inversion of the twisted Clifford action.
scope: What makes the native projection an InternalProjection instance.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Continuous sections only; no smooth sections and no principal-bundle structure.

short_claim: The tested deformation is generated by a native one-parameter Spin subgroup with an explicit projected action.
detailed_claim: transportState : R -> SpinGroup is a one-parameter subgroup of the intrinsic Spin group, generated by the deliberately selected Clifford direction cle 0 (transportElem l = cosh(l/2) + sinh(l/2) . cle 0); its native projection acts on the local model as the explicit closed form paraMap l = id + (cosh l - 1) paraPlane + sinh l paraSwap.
scope: The single Spin-side source of the Task-37/38 experiment: a selected control slice through the intrinsic Spin structure, not a classification of deformation directions.
forbidden_stronger_reading: It is a one-parameter subgroup of the group; it is not a connection, a transport form, a holonomy or an exponential of a curvature. It MUST NOT be read as the unique native Spin deformation, as a canonical direction selected by the primitive Euclidean input, or as an exhaustive description of the native Spin deformation space; cle 0 is a chosen spatial generator.

short_claim: The base gluing datum is additional information, not derivable from the local core.
detailed_claim: The same local pieces admit inequivalent emergent bases; BaseGluingData is a genuinely new input beyond the local algebra.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Does not classify the possible base gluings.

short_claim: The emergent base is a charted space over the four-dimensional local model.
detailed_claim: Space B is the quotient of the disjoint pieces by the gluing relation, and it carries the Task-32 charted-space structure over LocalModel.
forbidden_stronger_reading: No smoothness at this stage.

short_claim: A smooth base gluing produces a C-infinity four-manifold.
detailed_claim: If the gluing maps are smooth (SmoothGluing) then Space B is a C-infinity manifold over the local model in Mathlib's sense, with the Task-32 atlas.
assumptions: CLAIM-G002 and the smoothness of the primitive.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Smoothness is an assumption on the primitive; it is not derived, and a continuous-only counterexample is given in the same module.

short_claim: The emergent smooth four-manifold certificate.
detailed_claim: Under a closed gluing graph and countable index type, Space B is Hausdorff, second countable, charted, a C-infinity manifold, and modelled on a four-dimensional real space.
assumptions: CLAIM-G003 plus the two stated hypotheses.
forbidden_stronger_reading: No claim about diffeomorphism type, compactness, homotopy type or global topology of Space B.

short_claim: The tangent transitions of the emergent manifold are the derivatives of the gluing maps.
detailed_claim: For the actual Task-33 atlas, the coordinate changes of Mathlib's tangent bundle are exactly D(phi_ij).
scope: Genuine tangent geometry, not a postulated model fibre.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Does not trivialise TM and does not identify TM with the internal bundle.

short_claim: The solder is an additional coupling datum.
detailed_claim: Base gluing together with native Spin transition data does not force any identification of internal Lorentz transitions with tangent transitions.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Does not say that solders never exist.

short_claim: A weak (merely fibrewise) solder is insufficient.
detailed_claim: There is a weak solder datum whose local representative and whose induced metric fail to be continuous; the weak notion does not deliver tangent geometry.
scope: Explicit counterexample on a flat one-chart base.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Does not quantify how far weak solders are from regular ones.

short_claim: A regular solder is exactly a regular bundle equivalence between the internal Lorentz bundle and TM.
detailed_claim: Nonempty (SmoothTangentSolderData B S) holds if and only if there is a fibrewise linear total-space equivalence over the identity, continuous in both directions, with C-infinity local representatives, between the internal Lorentz bundle of S and the tangent bundle of Space B.
scope: The coupling primitive has no hidden content beyond a bundle equivalence at this regularity; the certified Lorentz-side smoothness is that of the projected transition representatives in chart coordinates.
forbidden_stronger_reading: It is NOT a smooth bundle equivalence in the strong sense: the total-space maps are continuous and only the local representatives are C-infinity. The missing stronger total-space smooth package is an INFRASTRUCTURE / PACKAGING limitation (the pinned Mathlib has no vector-bundle morphism or equivalence type, and IsContMDiff is stated over the base manifold while the solder supplies ContDiffOn in chart coordinates); it MUST NOT be explained by saying that the native Spin cocycle is only continuous, since a regular smooth solder already gives smooth projected Lorentz transition representatives. No smooth Spin transition functions are postulated, and smooth projected Lorentz data MUST NOT be presented as a packaged smooth intrinsic Spin Lie-group bundle theory (CLAIM-B001).

short_claim: A regular solder induces a smooth tangent Lorentz metric of signature (1,3).
detailed_claim: Given a regular solder, the induced metric coefficients are C-infinity on every chart domain, symmetric, nondegenerate, transform as a (0,2) tensor under the genuine tangent transitions, and have signature (1,3) in every solder frame.
scope: The Lorentzian tangent geometry of the regular-solder sector.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Conditional: it does not assert that a regular solder exists for a given base. No connection, curvature or torsion is produced.

short_claim: The transported tangent form is chart independent.
detailed_claim: Computed in any solder frame whose patch contains the point, the transported bilinear form is the same, because two frames differ by an element of GLor and GLor preserves the intrinsic form.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Holds already at the weak solder level; regularity is a separate matter.

short_claim: A regular solder forces orientation compatibility of the emergent atlas.
detailed_claim: From a regular solder one constructs a nowhere-zero continuous chartwise function whose transformation law forces the determinants of all tangent transitions to be compatible; no orientation datum was assumed anywhere in the bottom-up construction.
forbidden_stronger_reading: This is NOT the standard statement w1(TM) = 0: the project has no Stiefel-Whitney classes and no comparison theorem with them.

short_claim: A nontrivial orientation obstruction rules out every regular solder.
detailed_claim: If no chartwise orientation datum exists, then no native Spin transition datum over that base admits a regular solder.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Project-native; no characteristic class is computed.

short_claim: A regular solder forces the project-native Spin obstruction to vanish.
detailed_claim: The fixed-cover kernel-valued lifting obstruction of the projected Lorentz cocycle is the trivial class whenever a regular solder exists.
forbidden_stronger_reading: This is NOT w2(TM) = 0; see CLAIM-B002.

short_claim: A nontrivial project-native Spin obstruction rules out the solder.
detailed_claim: If the obstruction class of a visible Lorentz cocycle is nontrivial, there is no native Spin datum projecting to it that admits a regular solder.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Project-native only.

short_claim: A regular solder yields a coherent future-cone reduction.
detailed_claim: Every regular solder produces a TimeOrientationReduction of the internal Lorentz data; on the periodic control that reduction is glued across the overlaps.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Not proved equivalent to general time-orientability of the emergent manifold; see CLAIM-B006.

short_claim: The residual solder freedom is exactly a free transitive regular gauge action.
detailed_claim: For a fixed base and fixed native Spin seed, the regular tangent gauge fields form a group acting freely and transitively on the regular solder data, and any two solders differ by a unique gauge field.
assumptions: Fixed base and fixed Spin datum.
scope: The exact gauge freedom of the coupling.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Does not compare solders across different bases or different Spin data.

short_claim: The regular solder is a gate: it does not always exist.
detailed_claim: Over the Moebius-type orientation-reversing gluing no native Spin transition datum admits a regular solder.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be read as 'all four-manifolds admit the native solder'; it says the opposite for one explicit model.

short_claim: The discrete fixed-cover Spin-lift freedom survives the bottom-up construction.
detailed_claim: Over the one-loop control there are two native Spin data with the same projected Lorentz transitions, both soldered, not related by the kernel-valued fixed-cover gauge equivalence.
scope: The construction has not accidentally canonized the Spin structure.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Fixed-cover freedom; NOT a computation of H^1(M; Z/2). See CLAIM-B005.

short_claim: The fixed-cover lift multiplicity grows with the number of loops.
detailed_claim: With two independent loops there are four pairwise gauge-inequivalent native Spin data, all admitting regular solders.
scope: Instantiation of the 2^N pattern at N = 2.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Fixed-cover multiplicity only; see CLAIM-B005.

short_claim: The two gates reject the two adversarial controls independently.
detailed_claim: The orientation-reversing gluing is rejected by the determinant gate alone, while a nontrivial lifting obstruction is rejected by the triple-overlap gate alone.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Does not claim the two gates are independent in general, only that each rejects its control alone.

short_claim: The Task-36 adversarial battery is bundled in one certificate.
detailed_claim: adversarial_global_topology_certificate collects reconvergence, the two contrapositive gates, the smooth bundle packaging, the time-orientation reduction and the four concrete control models.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Blocked and external robustness cases are deliberately absent from it and are recorded separately.

short_claim: The frozen periodic control base is a genuine smooth four-manifold with a two-component overlap.
detailed_claim: loopGluingOf kappa LoopTwist.id' is a smooth base gluing whose emergent base is a smooth manifold; its fixed cover has two incidence components per loop, one of them a wrap-around.
scope: The control geometry used by Tasks 36-39.
forbidden_stronger_reading: It has NOT been proved homeomorphic to S^1 x R^3 and nothing about its fundamental group is proved. See CLAIM-B004.

short_claim: The tested native transition deformation is globally admissible for every finite parameter value on the frozen control.
detailed_claim: For the frozen periodic control base and the Task-37 native one-parameter Spin Cech-transition family, a regular tangent solder exists for every real parameter value, with an explicitly constructed compensating witness.
assumptions: The base gluing is held fixed (CONTROL A).
scope: This control base and this family only.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be read as 'every transition-cocycle deformation is admissible' or as a statement about co-varying bases.

short_claim: The admissibility locus of the tested family is the whole real line.
detailed_claim: regularRegion of the fixed-base family equals the universal set: the locus was solved exactly, not sampled.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Not a statement about other families; the selective family of Task 37 has a strictly smaller locus.

short_claim: Admissibility is symmetric under sign reversal of the parameter.
detailed_claim: ControlAAdmissible l holds if and only if ControlAAdmissible (-l) holds.
forbidden_stronger_reading: The sign is a direction along the Spin one-parameter subgroup; it is NOT a curvature sign.

short_claim: All tested parameter values lie in one full-Spin Cech gauge orbit.
detailed_claim: Any two parameter values of the family give native Spin cocycles related by a continuous chartwise gauge transformation with values in the whole structure group, using the project's own multiplication convention.
assumptions: As in CLAIM-S001; continuity is part of the gauge notion.
scope: This control and this family only.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be read as 'transition-cocycle deformations are pure gauge' in general. The Spin-side gauge is continuous, not smooth.

short_claim: The projected Lorentz cocycles are gauge related as well.
detailed_claim: The same Spin-side gauge, pushed through the native projection, relates the projected Lorentz cocycles at any two parameter values.
forbidden_stronger_reading: No independent Lorentz-side relabelling is introduced; it is the projection of the Spin gauge.

short_claim: At the narrower kernel-valued equivalence the parameter values are distinguished.
detailed_claim: For a nonzero parameter the deformed datum is not equivalent to the neutral one under the project's kernel-valued fixed-cover gauge equivalence, because a kernel relabelling cannot move the projection.
forbidden_stronger_reading: This is a statement about lift labels, NOT a geometric distinction and NOT a contradiction with CLAIM-S004.

short_claim: There is an explicit certified regular solder branch for every finite parameter value.
detailed_claim: The witness is the identity comparison on the first patch of each loop and the projected transport state at an interpolated parameter on the second; smoothness, fibrewise invertibility and the exact intertwining equation are proved on every overlap component.
assumptions: As in CLAIM-S001; the construction uses the coordinate gap inside the second slab.
scope: This control only; a cover without such room is not covered.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Not an existence theorem for regular solders in general.

short_claim: Along the explicit branch the induced tangent Lorentz metric is exactly parameter independent.
detailed_claim: The Task-34/35 solder-transported tangent metrics of the explicit witnesses are literally equal at every point and on every pair of tangent vectors, for all parameter values.
scope: The explicit certified branch on this control.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Not a statement about any invariant the project has not defined, and in particular nothing about curvature.

short_claim: The projected Lorentz gauge of the smoke test is smooth; the Spin-side gauge is only continuous.
detailed_claim: The projected gauge transformation, written in chart coordinates, is C-infinity on every chart domain of the control; the Spin-side gauge remains certified as continuous only.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be read as smoothness of the Spin cocycle gauge; the intrinsic SpinGroup has no smooth structure (CLAIM-B001).

short_claim: The regular solder solution spaces at two parameter values correspond, with equal induced tangent metrics.
detailed_claim: There is an explicit bijection between the regular solder solution spaces of the deformed data at two parameter values, given by precomposition with the projected gauge, and corresponding solutions induce literally the same tangent Lorentz metric.
assumptions: The frozen periodic control base and the Task-37 family.
scope: This control only; the transport uses the smoothness of CLAIM-S009. THM-S017 and THM-S018 are the definitions (constructions) the theorems are about; they are listed in supporting_construction_ids and are not proofs.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Not a general transport theorem for arbitrary bases, arbitrary deformations or arbitrary gauges.

short_claim: Scientific reading of the smoke test.
detailed_claim: On the frozen periodic control base, the currently formalized native Spin Cech-transition deformation has no closure selection power and no effect on the induced tangent Lorentz metric; it is absorbable by full-Spin Cech gauge on that control. The first tested knob therefore sits above the level at which a geometric or dynamical deformation could live.
scope: An interpretation of the certified statements, scoped to the control.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be written as 'transition-cocycle deformations are pure gauge' or as 'a transition-cocycle deformation is a change of trivialisation, not a change of geometry' without the control scope; a GENERAL CECH-DEFORMATION CLASSIFICATION IS NOT PROVED, and the statement MUST NOT be turned into a statement about curvature.

short_claim: Weak-solder insufficiency control.
detailed_claim: An explicit weak solder whose local representative is discontinuous shows that the fibrewise Task-34 notion does not deliver tangent geometry.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Does not measure the size of the gap.

short_claim: Discontinuous induced metric control.
detailed_claim: The metric induced by that weak solder is itself not continuous, so regularity of the metric is not automatic from the fibrewise law.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Not a claim about all weak solders.

short_claim: Orientation-reversing no-solder control.
detailed_claim: The Moebius-type gluing admits no regular solder for any native Spin datum, and the failure is located at the orientation gate.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Does not classify which gluings fail.

short_claim: Independent Spin obstruction control.
detailed_claim: A kernel-valued sign twist produces two native Spin data over the same projected cocycle which are distinguished by the project's fixed-cover notion, so the obstruction layer is not vacuous.
scope: Abstract control over an arbitrary base with a two-patch cover.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Not a statement about characteristic classes.

short_claim: Fixed-cover discrete lift-freedom control.
detailed_claim: The bottom-up construction does not remove the discrete Spin-lift freedom; it is exhibited on the one-loop and two-loop controls.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Not H^1(M; Z/2).

short_claim: Task-37 anti-vacuity controls for the closure predicate.
detailed_claim: There is no universal existence theorem for regular closure solutions, and an explicit co-varying family is admissible exactly at the neutral parameter value; so the closure observable can select.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Shows the predicate has content; it does not classify admissible families.

short_claim: Task-38 pure-gauge smoke-test control record.
detailed_claim: The kernel-valued equivalence separates the parameter values, so the positive gauge result of CLAIM-S004 is not an artefact of a degenerate equivalence relation.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Not a geometric distinction.

short_claim: Combinatorial label control.
detailed_claim: Abstract Spin-foam-style labels carry no information that forces a regular solder.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Not a statement about any published spin-foam model.

short_claim: Spin-type data do not imply a tangent Lorentz coupling.
detailed_claim: Over the Moebius-type gluing native Spin transition data exist while no regular solder does.
forbidden_stronger_reading: This is not the classical S^4 separation theorem.

short_claim: Positive control: the gates are not vacuously closed.
detailed_claim: On the one-chart base a regular solder exists, there is no overlap obstruction and no artificial sign family appears.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Nothing global is tested by it.

short_claim: There is no smooth Lie-group package for the intrinsic Spin group.
detailed_claim: SpinGroup and GLor are certified as topological groups only: there is no smooth structure and no exponential map, hence no Lie-group package and no infinitesimal object of the Spin group. (The Lorentz side does carry the certified skew Lie algebra gB/gBLie, CLAIM-L011; the missing item is the bridge, CLAIM-B010.) Consequently the Spin-side Cech gauge notion carries continuity, not smoothness, and the smooth statement of CLAIM-S009 is available on the projected side only.
scope: Regularity boundary of the whole Spin side.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be papered over by calling the Spin cocycle gauge smooth, and MUST NOT be stated as 'the project has no Lie algebra': it has one on the Lorentz side (CLAIM-L011).

short_claim: The project-native Spin obstruction is not formally compared with w2(TM).
detailed_claim: The obstruction of CLAIM-G013 is the fixed-cover kernel-valued class of the project's own Cech layer. No Stiefel-Whitney class, no H^2(M; Z/2) and no comparison theorem exists in this repository.
scope: Interpretation boundary of the reconvergence result.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be stated as 'w1(TM) = w2(TM) = 0 has been proved'.

short_claim: No connection, parallel transport, holonomy or curvature exists in the project.
detailed_claim: There is no transport one-form, no covariant derivative, no path-ordered exponential, no loop-transport functional, no field strength, no Riemann tensor, no Einstein equation and no cosmological statement anywhere in the source. The deformation-branch firewall enforces that no declaration in the deformation branch is even named after such an object.
scope: The principal boundary of the present phase.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be weakened to 'a Spin connection is present'.

short_claim: The periodic control model is not proved to be S^1 x R^3.
detailed_claim: Neither a homeomorphism Space B ~ S^1 x R^3 nor any statement about the fundamental group of the control base is proved or used. The proved content is the two-component periodic overlap pattern of the fixed cover.
scope: Interpretation boundary of the control geometry.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be described as a proved circle-times-space model.

short_claim: Fixed-cover lift freedom is not global H^1(M; Z/2).
detailed_claim: The multiplicity statements are about the fixed cover of the control model. No direct limit over refinements is taken and no cohomology group of the emergent manifold is computed.
scope: Interpretation boundary of the multiplicity results.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be stated as a computation of H^1(M; Z/2).

short_claim: The time-orientation reduction is not proved equivalent to general time-orientability.
detailed_claim: The reduction is a coherent chartwise future-cone choice in the project's own sense; no theorem relates it to the standard notion of a time-orientable Lorentzian manifold.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be stated as 'the emergent manifold is time orientable' in the standard sense.

short_claim: There is no general existence theorem for the regular solder.
detailed_claim: All solder-dependent global results are conditional. Existence has been constructed only for explicit control models, and it provably fails for the Moebius-type control.
scope: Scope boundary of CLAIM-G009 to CLAIM-G015.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be stated as 'all four-manifolds admit the native solder'. In the machine-readable registries the solder types are classified GATE_DATA: the definition is derived, the inhabitance is not.

short_claim: No gravitational dynamics has been derived.
detailed_claim: No field equation, no action principle, no Einstein equation and no cosmological classification appears anywhere in the project.
scope: The outermost boundary of the project.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be weakened in any manuscript wording.

short_claim: Where the next genuinely nontrivial deformation might live is an open question.
detailed_claim: The smoke test locates the first tested knob too high. The likely next layer is a connection / parallel transport / holonomy layer below the Cech transition functions, but this is a research direction and not a proved conclusion.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be presented as a prediction or as a proved statement about where the deformation lives.

short_claim: One Lean certificate aggregates the frozen intermediate state.
detailed_claim: Closure.intermediate_milestone_certificate, together with its four component certificates, states in one place the local core, the global layer (with all solder-dependent items conditional), the surviving discrete lift freedom and the smoke test at exactly its proved scope. If any aggregated endpoint is weakened or removed, the closure module stops compiling.
assumptions: Those of the aggregated theorems; the global part is parameterized by an arbitrary smooth base gluing and native Spin datum.
forbidden_stronger_reading: Aggregation does not strengthen any conjunct, and the certificate contains no conjunct about connections, curvature or dynamics.

short_claim: The deformation experiment has a theorem-level interface record.
detailed_claim: A theorem records what the experiment varies (the native Spin transition state), what is derived (the Lorentz transition, only through the native projection), what is held fixed (the base gluing, proved fixed, not assumed) and what is solved for (a regular tangent solder).
forbidden_stronger_reading: The record lists absent objects (transport forms, loop functionals, field strengths) as absent; it does not supply them.

short_claim: The project already contains an intrinsic six-dimensional Lorentz-skew Lie-algebra layer.
detailed_claim: The intrinsic Lorentz carrier carries a Lie algebra SpinCore.gB / SpinCore.gBLie of endomorphisms skew for the project's own polarized form BS: the commutator of two skew endomorphisms is skew, the Lie bracket of gBLie is that commutator, the linear equivalence bivectorEquivSkew identifies the bivector space (the exterior square of the carrier) with gB and sends a decomposable wedge u v to Kend u v, and the finite rank of gB is 6.
assumptions: None beyond the primitive Euclidean datum and the derived carrier with its form BS.
scope: An algebraic statement about the intrinsic Lorentz sector; no topology, no smooth structure, no Spin group.
forbidden_stronger_reading: This is not yet a formal theorem identifying it with Lie(SpinGroup). There is no Lie(SpinGroup) object in the repository, no proved equivalence Lie(SpinGroup) =~ gB and no differential of the native cover. See CLAIM-B010, CLAIM-B011, OP-012.
provenance: Proved in the E1 core (Task 10 branch 4); documented and registered at Task 40.

short_claim: The existing Lorentz-skew Lie algebra is not identified with an infinitesimal structure of the intrinsic Spin group.
detailed_claim: No object Lie(SpinGroup) exists in the repository, and no theorem relates gB / gBLie to an infinitesimal structure of SpinCore.SpinGroup. The certified Lie algebra lives on the Lorentz side and was built from the carrier and BS alone.
scope: The first open edge of the next phase.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be written as 'gB is the Lie algebra of the intrinsic SpinGroup', and MUST NOT be repaired by citing textbook facts about Lie(Spin(1,3)), which are not formalized here.

short_claim: There is no differential of the native Spin cover, and spinCover may not be applied to a connection one-form.
detailed_claim: SpinCore.spinCover is a group homomorphism SpinGroup -> GLor. No differential d-rho-e : Lie(SpinGroup) -> gB and no equivalent proved infinitesimal representation exists. Consequently any future Lorentz-side connection must be induced through such an infinitesimal map, and the expression spinCover composed with a Lie-algebra-valued one-form is not type-correct.
scope: A future architectural requirement, not a current theorem.
forbidden_stronger_reading: MUST NOT be presented as if the composite of the group-level cover with a connection one-form defined a Lorentz connection.
provenance: Recorded at Task 40; corrects the withdrawn Task-38/39 draft wording.
